title: Study for Nighttime, Enigma and Nostalgia

said.q: wounded birds, poverty, and one whole week of rain.
said.in: quoted in Hayden Herrera, Arshile Gorky: His Life and Work, New York, 2003, p. 192

said.q: he reached his artistic maturity several years before his friends and colleagues of the future New York School, and introduced a complex set of ideas and problems he did not live to resolve.
said.in: “Arshile Gorky: Poet in Paint”, in Carol Fuerstein ed., Arshile Gorky: A Retrospective, exh. cat., Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum, New York, 1981, p. 60

said.q: Executed circa 1930-1932, Study for Nighttime, Enigma and Nostalgia is a striking example from a formative period during Arshile Gorky’s career.

events.q: This work is catalogued in the Arshile Gorky Foundation Archives as AGF #D0162.
